author: Design Lead
text: We need to update our design system. The current color palette doesn't meet accessibility standards.

author: UX Designer
text: I've been working on WCAG AAA compliance. Increasing contrast ratios for all text elements.

author: Visual Designer
text: But won't higher contrast ratios make the design look too harsh? We need to maintain aesthetics.

author: Accessibility Specialist
text: We can achieve both. Using neutral backgrounds and softer accent colors helps balance accessibility and aesthetics.

author: Design Lead
text: Good point. Let's schedule a design review meeting next week to go through the new palette.

author: UI Developer
text: The responsive design breakpoints need adjustment. Mobile view is breaking on tablet sizes.

author: Senior Developer
text: We should add a tablet breakpoint. Currently we only have mobile and desktop breakpoints.

author: UI Developer
text: Great idea. I'll add breakpoints for 768px and 1024px. Should improve mobile experience significantly.

author: Product Manager
text: Users are requesting dark mode support. Can we prioritize this feature?

author: Design Lead
text: Dark mode would be a great addition. We should create a theme system to make switching seamless.

author: Frontend Developer
text: I can implement this using CSS custom properties and a context provider. Storage preference in localStorage.

author: Product Manager
text: Perfect! Let's add this to the next sprint. Timeline estimate?

author: Frontend Developer
text: About 2-3 days for implementation plus 1 day for testing. So roughly 4 days total.
